Job Description :

Internship – Data Science

Role Overview:
To support our Technology Department in the Advanced Materials division, we are looking for an Intern in Data Science . The position is a 6-month internship based at our Advanced Materials Innovation Center in Basel, Switzerland. The preferred start date is September 2026.

This role has been created to support the digital transformation of the Technology Department and contribute to ongoing knowledge management initiatives. We are looking for someone who is curious, analytical, and eager to apply data science, automation, and AI-related technologies in a multidisciplinary environment.

Do you think you’re the right fit for this opportunity? Apply today!

Role Responsibilities:
As an Intern in Data Science, you will be responsible for:

• Compile and analyze experimental data from archived projects to be utilized in data science initiatives

• Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that acquire, ingest, and process data from multiple sources into the enterprise Generative AI Platform.

• Develop, prototype, and test LLM-based architectures and agentic systems for processing large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to translate domain-specific problems into computational solutions, such as retrieval, ranking, and reasoning, in the fields of chemistry and materials science.

• Assist in the automation of manual processes & dashboards.

• Participate in code reviews and agile development cycles.

• Document data processing scripts, data workflows and generate technical reports.

• Work closely with a multidisciplinary team within Huntsman Advanced Materials, reporting into the Technology Department.

Experience and Competencies:
We are looking for candidates with a strong interest in data science, digital transformation, and applied AI technologies, who are motivated to learn and contribute in an international, collaborative environment.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree completed or currently enrolled in a Master’s programme in computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, or statistics.

• Strong programming skills in Python; JavaScript is a plus.

• Familiarity with LLMs, vector databases, and prompt engineering concepts.

• Familiarity with cloud service platforms, such as Azure.

• Basic knowledge of web development frameworks and SQL.

• Basic knowledge of machine learning is a plus.

• Knowledge of chemistry or materials science is a plus.

• Passion to learn and a collaborative mindset.

• Fluent in English.

• A proactive attitude, strong communication skills, and motivation to contribute to digital transformation in a technology-driven environment.

What next?
If you would like to join an innovative, collaborative and multicultural team, please apply now. Your application will be forwarded to a Talent Acquisition Partner, who will strive to get back to you as soon as they can. We understand that applying for a new job is a big decision and we will work hard to keep you updated and support you along the way.

About Us:
At Huntsman, we pride ourselves on being a people-oriented organization.
Our family-like atmosphere is cultivated by our diverse groups of team members around the world.
We welcome the talent, experience and fresh ideas that employees at all stages of their careers, from interns to seasoned professionals, bring to Huntsman.
In return, we offer you the opportunity to become an integral part of a dynamic, industry-leading company, where safety and ethics always come first.

Additional Locations:

Huntsman Corporation is a global manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals. The company operates a major production site in Monthey (Valais), Switzerland.

• Profile - Federal logistics brevet, Supply Chain diploma or equivalent - ADR and IATA/OACI training - a plus - Extensive experience in logistics and warehouse management - Leadership, safety sense and performance orientation - Knowledge of SAP, WMS and office tools - Native French, fluent English ## Main Tasks - Manage logistics and warehouse operations with a strong focus on EHS - Manage and develop a team of 6 to 15 employees - Optimize logistics processes, internal flows and performance KPIs - Manage the forklift fleet and internal/external transport - Ensure compliance with regulations for the transport of dangerous goods (ADR, IATA/OACI) - Prepare and accompany audits and inspections - Participate in site and group logistics improvement projects ## Application Interested individuals are invited to submit their complete application (cover letter, CV, diploma and work certificates) online. *LI-DF1
descriptionByLocale.de: Aufgaben Site Logistik- und Lagerverwalter ## Gewünschtes Profil - Bundesbrevet für Logistik, Supply Chain-Diplom oder gleichwertig - ADR- und IATA/OACI-Schulungen - ein Plus - Extensive Erfahrung in Logistik und Lagerverwaltung - Führungskompetenzen, Sicherheitsbewusstsein und Leistungsorientierung - Kenntnisse von SAP, WMS und Bürowerkzeugen - Muttersprachlich Französisch, fließend Englisch ## Hauptaufgaben - Verwalten von Logistik- und Lageroperationen mit starkem Fokus auf EHS - Verwalten und entwickeln eines Teams von 6 bis 15 Mitarbeitern - Optimieren von Logistikprozessen, internen Flüssen und Leistungskennzahlen - Verwalten der Gabelstaplerflotte und der internen/externen Transporte - Sicherstellen der Einhaltung der Vorschriften für den Transport gefährlicher Güter (ADR, IATA/OACI) - Vorbereiten und begleiten von Audits und Inspektionen - An Projekten zur Verbesserung der Logistik am Standort und in der Gruppe teilnehmen ## Bewerbung Interessierte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden aufgefordert, ihre vollständige Bewerbung (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Diplom und Arbeitszeugnisse) online einzureichen. *LI-DF1

Job Description : Nous recherchons pour piloter et optimiser les opérations logistiques et de stockage sur notre site de production de Monthey, un (e) Site Logistics & Warehousing Supervisor Le poste allie management d’équipe, excellence opérationnelle et un haut niveau de responsabilité en matière de sécurité et de conformité réglementaire. PROFIL SOUHAITÉ
• Brevet fédéral de logisticien, diplôme en Supply Chain ou équivalent
• Formations ADR et IATA/OACI – un plus
• Expérience confirmée en logistique et gestion de magasin
• Leadership, sens de la sécurité et orientation performance
• Maîtrise de SAP, WMS et des outils bureautiques
• Langues: Français langue maternelle, anglais courant TACHES PRINCIPALES
• Piloter les opérations logistiques et magasins avec un fort focus EHS
• Manager et développer une équipe de 6 à 15 collaborateurs
• Optimiser les processus logistiques, flux internes et KPI de performance
• Gérer le parc de chariots élévateurs et les transports internes/externes
• Garantir la conformité réglementaire pour le transport de marchandises dangereuses (ADR, IATA/OACI)
• Préparer et accompagner les audits et inspections
• Participer aux projets d’amélioration logistique du site et du groupe Les personnes intéressées sont priées d’adresser leur dossier de candidature complet (lettre de motivation, CV, diplôme(s) et certificat(s) de travail) en ligne. *LI-DF1 Additional Locations: Huntsman Corporation is a global manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals. The company operates a major production site in Monthey (Valais), Switzerland.
